name: android-kotlin
description: Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + Coroutines/Flow + Hilt + Gradle Kotlin DSL. An Android-only native app.

notes.platformBoundary: Tokens go in Android Keystore-backed storage — SharedPreferences is plaintext. Runtime permissions and manifest declarations come as a pair
notes.release: Store review is the only release path. Old app versions keep running, so API version negotiation is required
